name: Muddy Paws Rescue
notes:
501(c)(3) since 2016; 10,000+ dogs saved, ~900/yr, 200+ volunteers. NYC foster-based dog rescue (Pack HQ, NY 10019 - by appointment, meet dogs at events) partnering with open-intake shelters; conversation-based open-adoption model. Strong post-adoption behavior resources. Register at /adopt then email adoptionmeetings@ to set a meeting. Email is the fastest channel. Intake: behavior resources ('Pack Perks') on site

They do not take owner surrenders, or strays that were not originally adopted from them, because their foster homes are full of dogs from open-intake shelters. They are still adopting out.
